description: What the authenticated student still has to DO in one course: a per-module requirement graph where every row names the Canvas endpoint and field its verdict came from. Richer than list_modules plus list_module_items, which return a raw `completion_requirement` without the cross-references that make it truthful; for grade outcomes use project_grade or explain_grade instead, and for cross-course context list_my_planner_items. Five things to read before acting on the output: (1) `unknown` is a real state and is NOT "unsatisfied" — Canvas attaches `completion_requirement.completed` only where it loaded a module progression, which happens only for a student caller, so an educator or admin token gets `unknown` on every row rather than a course full of incomplete work. (2) A module with `requirement_type: "one"` is COMPLETE as soon as any single requirement is met, so counting its unsatisfied rows invents work. (3) `summary` gives five counts and never one "things left to do" number: that number cannot be computed honestly across mixed `requirement_type` values and a non-zero `unknown` count. (4) Numeric threshold rows are re-evaluated by Canvas on every pass and can revert from met to unmet with no student action (a regrade, a posting-policy change); the other four requirement types latch. (5) `canvas_state` and `derived_state` are both reported and a mismatch is flagged in `state_disagreement` rather than resolved. Read-only and current-user-only: no student_id parameter, no attempt started, no LTI launch, nothing marked as viewed or done.

include_context.description: Attach planner context (`plannable_date`, submission status) to each row. Default false. Context NEVER changes a row’s state — it is attached after the state is decided. Note Canvas’s planner defaults to a ~2-week window, so most rows will have `context: null` even with this on.

include_discussions.description: Add the discussion obligations that are not module completion requirements: the `require_initial_post` row (derived from the topic’s `require_initial_post` and `user_can_see_posts`, valid only for a student caller) and the two rows of a checkpointed discussion. Default true. Costs one course-level discussions call, plus one call per group the student owns a child topic in.

max_modules.description: Maximum modules to walk (default 50, maximum 200). When the limit is reached, `truncated` is true and `truncation_note` says what to change.

name: get_my_course_requirements
title: Get My Course Requirements
